issues.title: GM 12630084 webpage marketing belt-drive text conflicts with exact gear-drive specification and Saab B207 procedure
issues.cause: Generic GM marketing copy describes a belt-driven pump, whereas part-specific GM specification says Gear and Saab WIS uses internal balancer-shaft pump pinion.
symptoms: A parts listing describes serpentine belt drive on B207 water pump
An installer plans external-belt access instead of factory pump removal
issues.diagnosis_summary: Use exact GM SKU specification and factory Saab B207 cooling system procedure, confirm OE kit hardware and installed part; preserve document-level text conflict.
issues.correction_summary: Do not follow unrelated generic GM procedure; actual B207 pump removal needs the correct factory holding tools and coolant/timing-drive safety work.
limits: No procedure inferred from generic marketing
Original MY2004 WIS source, verify MY2005–06 revisions
